text:
linkbot: automated docs scan finished: found 12 shortlink redirects and 3 staging image 403s under /runtime-guide. Auto-PR creation scheduled for 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC. Use `/linkbot pause <path>` to halt for a path.

sam: heads-up — auto-PRs for docs can be noisy. can we hold the auto-PRs for /runtime-guide until owners sign off? :eyes:

linh: I'm the doc owner for runtime-guide snippets. please pause — a few of those images need rehosting (can't go straight to PR).

tara: @linkbot can you pause for `docs/runtime-guide`? if you can't, I'll close any auto-PRs until we have owners assigned. :handshake:

linkbot: pause request acknowledged. Auto-PR creation will be blocked for the prefix `docs/runtime-guide` at next run.

olivia: FYI the three images are: `setup-arch.png`, `kv-cache-heatmap.png`, `batching-latency.png`. I can rehost to `static.redwood.internal` and open one PR to replace shortlinks. Quick sed I plan to run locally: `sed -i "s|https://short.io/rdw-|/static.redwood.internal/|g" $(rg -l "short.io/rdw-" docs/runtime-guide)`

mohit: ping me for review, I'll do a fast pass. prefer a single PR that lists changed paths and alt text checks.

sam: can you also add the accessibility checklist line? `- images: alt text present + hosted on internal CDN` — that's a quick policy add for the runtime-guide.

linh: will add the checklist item to the guide's maintainer notes after the PR merges. thanks @olivia for taking this.

olivia: opening a small PR now — PR #8246 (replace shortlinks + rehost images + alt text). cc @mohit for review. :rocket:

github-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8246 — files changed: docs/runtime-guide/setup.md, docs/runtime-guide/performance.md, docs/runtime-guide/caching.md

mohit: quick look — two nits (alt text phrasing + one broken anchor). I'll push the nit fix on top of the PR if that's ok. :+1:

linh: please do. once it's merged i'll add the owner label and close the backlog items. also can someone add a short sentence to the runbook that auto-PRs require owner opt-in? avoids surprise patches.

sam: i'll add a single-sentence policy to the runbook and drop a note in the docs-maintainers checklist.

tara: thanks all. once merged i'll re-run the scan for the other spaces. if anyone wants to opt back into auto-PR creation for a path use `/linkbot enable <path>` or ping here. :sparkles:
